# ClawQL documentation

> ClawQL is an MCP server for OpenAPI, Swagger, and Google Discovery APIs — search and execute tools, optional vault memory, sandbox, schedule, notify, and defense-in-depth controls.

This file helps AI agents and crawlers find canonical documentation. For full-text Markdown of any page, send `Accept: text/markdown` on that URL.

## Getting started
- [Agent setup](https://docs.clawql.com/agent-setup): Desktop onboarding, Cursor iOS Cloud Agents, local sandbox
- [Quickstart](https://docs.clawql.com/quickstart): Fastest path to a running gateway
- [Getting started](https://docs.clawql.com/getting-started): Quickstart paths, teams, and 7.0 migration
- [Install](https://docs.clawql.com/install): npm, Docker, and Helm install options

## Core reference
- [MCP tools](https://docs.clawql.com/tools): search, execute, audit, cache, and optional tools
- [Inference](https://docs.clawql.com/inference/clawql-inference): Gateway, flywheel, and wiring
- [Plugins](https://docs.clawql.com/plugins): Gateway core and optional plugin packages
- [Protocol](https://docs.clawql.com/reference/protocol): Uniform envelope and approval flows
- [Spec configuration](https://docs.clawql.com/spec-configuration): OpenAPI and provider sources

## Deployment & security
- [Deployment](https://docs.clawql.com/deployment): Docker, Kubernetes, and operations
- [Defense in depth](https://docs.clawql.com/security/defense-in-depth): Layered MCP security model
- [Security best practices](https://docs.clawql.com/security/best-practices): 32-module agentic AI security series

## Agent discovery
- [AGENTS.md](https://docs.clawql.com/AGENTS.md): MCP proxy and blocked-tool behavior
- [Agent skills](https://docs.clawql.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): RFC agent skills index
- [API catalog](https://docs.clawql.com/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset
- [MCP server card](https://docs.clawql.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): MCP server metadata

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/danielsmithdevelopment/ClawQL): source code and issues
